---
title: "02_sample_construction"
output: html_document
---

## Overview

Takes the **locked parent-only sample produced by `01_datacleaning_primary.Rmd`**,
adds the piecewise growth-model variables, validates the dyadic structure, and
exports long, person-wide, and Mplus-ready files.

This script **does not re-select the parent sample or re-derive the event
anchor**. The signal variable created in `01` is the single source of truth.

**Requires:** `01_datacleaning_primary.Rmd` (reads from `data/derived/`)

**Outputs:**

- `data/multilevel_analyses.csv` — observed long-format person-years
- `data/sem_analyses.csv` — one row per person, signals 0–7 in wide format
- `data/mplus_parent.dat` — one row per couple for Mplus
- `data/derived/mplus_parent_couple_key.csv` — couple-ID crosswalk
- `data/derived/final_parent_long.rds` — long analysis object
- `data/derived/final_parent_wide.rds` — person-wide analysis object

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
options(scipen = 999)

EXPECTED_N_COUPLES <- 679L
EXPECTED_N_PEOPLE  <- 1358L
EXPECTED_N_OBS     <- 10746L

MIN_LS_OBS         <- 6L
MANDATORY_SIGNALS  <- c(0L, 2L, 3L)
MPLUS_MISSING      <- 999
```

```{r load-inputs}
ls_partner_data     <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "ls_partner_data.rds"))
parent_couple_info  <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "parent_couple_info.rds"))
parent_flow_summary <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "parent_flow_summary.rds"))

cat("\n--- Parent sample inherited from 01 ---\n")
cat("Couples:", n_distinct(ls_partner_data$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(ls_partner_data$pid), "\n")
cat("Observed person-years:", nrow(ls_partner_data), "\n")

stopifnot(n_distinct(ls_partner_data$couple_id) == EXPECTED_N_COUPLES)
stopifnot(n_distinct(ls_partner_data$pid) == EXPECTED_N_PEOPLE)
stopifnot(nrow(ls_partner_data) == EXPECTED_N_OBS)
```

```{r inherited-flow}
cat("\n--- Sample-construction flow from 01 ---\n")
print(as_tibble(parent_flow_summary))
```

```{r growth-model-variables}
# IMPORTANT:
# signal was already defined in 01 from the couple-level first-child reporting
# year. Do not reconstruct signal from first_birth/interview_month here.
#
# Piecewise coding (CORRECTED parameterization, matching Mplus models 10e/10f):
#   slope1 = pre-event change: 0,1,2 and then held at 2
#   jump   = level shift beginning at signal 3 (the event year)
#   slope2 = post-event change: 0 at signals 0-3, then 1,2,3,4
#
# Under this parameterization, the jump parameter represents the TOTAL
# change from signal 2 to signal 3 (the event-year shift). Slope2 begins
# accumulating only at signal 4 onward.
#
# NOTE: An earlier version coded slope2 = pmax(signal - 2L, 0L), which gave
# slope2 = 1 at signal 3. That matched the OLD parameterization (model 10d,
# now superseded). The corrected coding below matches models 10a-10c, 10e, 10f.

final_couples <- ls_partner_data %>%
  mutate(
    signal = as.integer(signal),
    female = if_else(sex == 2, 1L, 0L),
    male   = if_else(sex == 1, 1L, 0L),
    slope1 = pmin(signal, 2L),
    jump   = if_else(signal >= 3L, 1L, 0L),
    slope2 = pmax(signal - 3L, 0L)
  )

# Expected piecewise design matrix (corrected parameterization).
expected_growth_codes <- tibble(
  signal = 0:7,
  slope1 = c(0L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L),
  jump   = c(0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L),
  slope2 = c(0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L)
)

observed_growth_codes <- final_couples %>%
  distinct(signal, slope1, jump, slope2) %>%
  arrange(signal)

cat("\n--- Piecewise growth coding ---\n")
print(observed_growth_codes)

stopifnot(
  nrow(observed_growth_codes) == 8L,
  all(observed_growth_codes$signal == expected_growth_codes$signal),
  all(observed_growth_codes$slope1 == expected_growth_codes$slope1),
  all(observed_growth_codes$jump   == expected_growth_codes$jump),
  all(observed_growth_codes$slope2 == expected_growth_codes$slope2)
)
```

```{r validation}
cat("\n--- Structural validation ---\n")

# 01 already supplied only observed life-satisfaction rows.
stopifnot(!any(is.na(final_couples$life_sat)))
stopifnot(all(final_couples$signal %in% 0:7))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(final_couples[, c("pid", "syear")]))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(final_couples[, c("couple_id", "pid", "signal")]))

member_check <- final_couples %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, sex) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_male = sum(sex == 1),
    n_female = sum(sex == 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(member_check$n_members == 2))
stopifnot(all(member_check$n_male == 1 & member_check$n_female == 1))

person_check <- final_couples %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    has_signal0 = any(signal == 0),
    has_signal2 = any(signal == 2),
    has_signal3 = any(signal == 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(person_check$n_obs >= MIN_LS_OBS & person_check$n_obs <= 8))
stopifnot(all(person_check$has_signal0 & person_check$has_signal2 & person_check$has_signal3))

cat("Couples:", n_distinct(final_couples$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(final_couples$pid), "\n")
cat("Observed person-years:", nrow(final_couples), "\n")
cat("Couples missing mandatory signals:",
    person_check %>%
      group_by(couple_id) %>%
      summarise(ok = all(has_signal0 & has_signal2 & has_signal3), .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(!ok) %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("Couples with fewer than 12 observed rows:",
    final_couples %>%
      count(couple_id, name = "n") %>%
      filter(n < 12) %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("Non-heterosexual couples:",
    member_check %>%
      filter(!(n_male == 1 & n_female == 1)) %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

cat("\nObserved LS rows per participant:\n")
print(person_check %>% count(n_obs))
```

```{r event-anchor-validation}
# The analytic event is the reporting-year anchor established in 01.
# Signal 3 must therefore equal reporting_year for every observed signal-3 row.
anchor_check <- final_couples %>%
  filter(signal == 3) %>%
  summarise(all_aligned = all(syear == reporting_year)) %>%
  pull(all_aligned)

stopifnot(anchor_check)

# Each retained couple must have the same reporting year for both partners.
reporting_check <- final_couples %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, reporting_year) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(n_reporting_years = n_distinct(reporting_year), .groups = "drop")

stopifnot(all(reporting_check$n_reporting_years == 1))
```

```{r export-long-and-wide}
# Long file contains observed person-years only, which is appropriate for
# multilevel analyses using the available repeated observations.
write.csv(
  final_couples,
  here("data", "multilevel_analyses.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Build an explicit 0-7 skeleton so every signal column exists even when an
# individual is missing one or two waves.
wide_couples <- final_couples %>%
  select(couple_id, pid, sex, signal, life_sat) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(couple_id, pid, sex),
    signal = 0:7
  ) %>%
  arrange(couple_id, pid, signal) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = signal,
    values_from = life_sat,
    names_prefix = "signal_"
  ) %>%
  select(couple_id, pid, sex, all_of(paste0("signal_", 0:7)))

stopifnot(nrow(wide_couples) == EXPECTED_N_PEOPLE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(wide_couples$pid))

# Re-check the 6/8 requirement in wide form.
wide_obs_check <- wide_couples %>%
  mutate(n_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(paste0("signal_", 0:7))))))
stopifnot(all(wide_obs_check$n_obs >= MIN_LS_OBS))

write.csv(
  wide_couples,
  here("data", "sem_analyses.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  final_couples,
  here("data", "derived", "final_parent_long.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  wide_couples,
  here("data", "derived", "final_parent_wide.rds")
)

cat("Exported multilevel_analyses.csv and sem_analyses.csv\n")
```

```{r mplus-format}
male_wide <- wide_couples %>%
  filter(sex == 1) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("signal_", "M_LS", .x), starts_with("signal_")) %>%
  rename(PID_M = pid) %>%
  select(couple_id, PID_M, all_of(paste0("M_LS", 0:7)))

female_wide <- wide_couples %>%
  filter(sex == 2) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("signal_", "F_LS", .x), starts_with("signal_")) %>%
  rename(PID_F = pid) %>%
  select(couple_id, PID_F, all_of(paste0("F_LS", 0:7)))

stopifnot(nrow(male_wide) == EXPECTED_N_COUPLES)
stopifnot(nrow(female_wide) == EXPECTED_N_COUPLES)

mplus_couple_key <- wide_couples %>%
  distinct(couple_id) %>%
  arrange(couple_id) %>%
  mutate(couple_id_num = row_number())

mplus_data <- male_wide %>%
  inner_join(female_wide, by = "couple_id") %>%
  left_join(mplus_couple_key, by = "couple_id") %>%
  mutate(PARENT = 1L) %>%
  select(
    couple_id_num,
    PARENT,
    PID_M,
    all_of(paste0("M_LS", 0:7)),
    PID_F,
    all_of(paste0("F_LS", 0:7))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(mplus_data) == EXPECTED_N_COUPLES)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(mplus_data$couple_id_num)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(mplus_data$PID_M))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(mplus_data$PID_F))

mplus_data_export <- mplus_data
mplus_data_export[is.na(mplus_data_export)] <- MPLUS_MISSING

write.table(
  mplus_data_export,
  here("data", "mplus_parent.dat"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  mplus_couple_key,
  here("data", "derived", "mplus_parent_couple_key.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nCouples written to mplus_parent.dat:", nrow(mplus_data_export), "\n")
cat("Mplus missing-value code:", MPLUS_MISSING, "\n")
cat("Variable order for the Mplus NAMES statement:\n")
cat(
  paste(
    c(
      "couple_id_num", "PARENT", "PID_M", paste0("M_LS", 0:7),
      "PID_F", paste0("F_LS", 0:7)
    ),
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r final-summary}
cat("\n--- FINAL 02 SUMMARY ---\n")
cat("Parent couples:", n_distinct(final_couples$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(final_couples$pid), "\n")
cat("Observed person-years:", nrow(final_couples), "\n")
cat("Person-wide rows:", nrow(wide_couples), "\n")
cat("Dyadic Mplus rows:", nrow(mplus_data), "\n")
```
